## Overview

This directory contains standards and conventions for markdown documentation in enterprise environments. These standards ensure that all architecture documentation maintains a professional, readable, and standardized format across the entire project, enabling effective communication and collaboration in enterprise architecture.

Consistent documentation is crucial for effective communication and collaboration in enterprise architecture. These standards ensure that all architecture documentation maintains a professional, readable, and standardized format across the entire project.

## Examples of Markdown Standards

- Document structure and formatting conventions for consistent presentation
- Sequence diagram standards using Mermaid syntax for technical workflows
- Content organization patterns for different document types
- Style guidelines for headings, lists, tables, and code blocks
- Link and reference formatting for cross-document navigation
- Image and diagram embedding standards for visual clarity
